Maheriv Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · L'vivs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' Aryeh-Leib Rokeh and his son Nohum-Aron, members of the Belz Hasidic dynasty documented elsewhere in this collection, lived in Maheriv in the early 20th century, when three synagogues operated in the town. In September 1942, the Jewish community of Maheriv was deported to the Rava-Ruska ghetto, documented elsewhere in this collection, and later to the Bełżec death camp; some Jews were executed during the transports themselves.
